notes: Journeys' 2020s compass logo: a big pale-grey oval panel (deckled edge, faint dashed 'route' lines printed on it, black 15 cm return) mounted TILTED about 25-30 deg (rising to the right) over the entry, on a purple fascia with a lime-green paint-splash mural. The oval's tilt is real (the letters stand upright in a near-frontal frame), and the backer can't be rotated, so the oval is a traced flat part (an ellipse fitted to its edge). 'Journeys' is hand-drawn faux-neon: pale cyan-white lit tubes (channel, lit, small cyan glow), traced from the bright cores; the overlapping strokes of O-U-R-N merge into one shape (they cross on the real sign too). Compass marks traced as their own parts: two orange chevrons (left of J, after the N), two yellow arrows (above and below the J), a green globe in the O. Dashed route lines not modelled (printed, too faint). Size: oval about 2.4 x 1.2 m (guess, from the 3 m door opening); it hangs below the fascia band (mount_y -0.2).
